description: Observatoire des ondes - Relais mobiles 5G activés - Tours Métropole Val de Loire is a dataset listed in opendataTMVL open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Ce jeu de données recense et localise la dernière version des antennes mobiles 5G des différents opérateurs et les bandes de fréquences disponibles sur ces sites en France Métropolitaine. Enrichissement ajout des hiérarchies administratives. Coverage: Tours Métropole Val de Loire. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. Its keywords are territoire, amenagement, telephone, mobile, voix, data. The portal shows 325 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2018/11/open-licence.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tours-metropole-fr-portal.
